failuresAndAdjustments: Native expected-subject counterexample returned 200 before 728b848 and now refuses all nine mismatch requests with 403.

Original legacy product cannot back up its uppercase record (corrupt). UUID-specific validation uses explicit registered owner migrations; no automatic startup upgrade or successful restore/takeover claim.

Two final host probe attempts timed out at different annotation-selection/save steps. Focusing the material with a real click before setting the range preserved every assertion; final 26 cases passed.

First Mac school canonical reload assertion used the default five-second deadline while the product still showed loading. Waiting for the actual component followed by original-text verification passed.

Initial IME attempts failed while locked or without OS focus. Selecting the input source first and then automatically raising the actual test Chrome PID resolved focus; later acceptance used only the automatic probe.

The real IME exposes untrusted compositionend events in this Chrome pair. Native proof requires trusted keydown/compositionstart/update plus trusted beforeinput and input containing each confirmed Chinese word; the end flags remain recorded.

An IME probe reached 15 passing cases before its synthetic v4 import reused the v2 dependency resource identity and correctly returned 409. The fixture now assigns new resource identities to the later version; product code did not change.

Two Mac client stop/start attempts exposed a real shutdown hang caused by public preconnections. 6171351 closes owned public sockets after business drain; the minimal regression was red before the fix, and shutdown/drain/lifecycle tests passed 13/13 after it.
